description: A free OCI Distribution v2 registry: push, pull, manifests, tags and blob uploads, with auth, a rate limit and missing blobs as scenario settings.
name: oci-mock

settings.description: When true, every /v2/ call without a bearer token from the listener's /token endpoint answers 401 with a WWW-Authenticate challenge.
settings.name: auth_required

settings.description: Requests per rolling 60 seconds the /v2/ API answers before it answers 429; 0 is no limit. Every /v2/ request counts, whatever the limit was when it arrived.
settings.name: rate_limit

settings.description: Comma-separated sha256 digests whose blob answers 404 BLOB_UNKNOWN, stored or not; empty is none.
settings.name: missing_blob
